description: This file defines types and utility functions related to legacy configuration migration, including rules, migration application, and helper functions for handling records, commands, and agents.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Returns the record if the value is a record, otherwise null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures a record exists at the specified key in the root object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Merges properties from source into target, skipping undefined and blocked keys, and merging nested records.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Maps a value to a command object if it represents a safe executable command with optional timeout.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of agents from an agents record.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from raw configuration, falling back to routing or 'main'.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent entry with a specific ID exists in the list, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Returns the provided migration object, possibly for type consistency.
